profile.headline: ISG SW2 @ Dell Technologies | MSAI Student @ UT Austin | Alumni @ UPRM
profile.summary:
Wepa! I’m José Serrano Rivera. I’m a software engineer at Dell Technologies. I help teams plan smarter, communicate better, and build reliable solutions for enterprise storage systems. I enjoy blending technical problem-solving with people-focused collaboration, especially when working across multiple teams in our Scrum@Scale environment.

I studied Computer Engineering at UPRM and I’m currently pursuing my M.S. in Artificial Intelligence at UT Austin. I’m excited about how AI, automation, and strong engineering practices can improve how teams deliver high-quality software.

Outside of work, you’ll probably find me walking around Austin, enjoying boba or a good coffee, or watching Formula 1 while overthinking race strategy.

Always open to connecting, whether it’s about tech, AI, Agile, coffee spots, or the latest F1 drama. Let’s chat!

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Project: GUI Test Automation and Quality Assurance for Enterprise Storage Systems (PowerStore)

• Performed regression testing across the product GUI’s React/TypeScript interface to ensure stability and functionality.

• Modernized the legacy GUI test framework by migrating to Playwright, cutting execution time by ~67% and strengthening reliability via Jenkins CI pipeline.

• Collaborate with developers and product owners to validate new UI features, identify defects, and support timely release readiness through both automated and manual testing.


Project: Intra-Cluster Data Migration for Enterprise Storage Systems (PowerStore)

• Led development and review of comprehensive intra-cluster migration testing using Python, ensuring coverage across legacy, next-generation, and cross-generation systems.

• Investigated, troubleshooted, and resolved defect tickets related to intra-cluster migration, ensuring timely, high-quality fixes and clear documentation.

• Developed performance testing scripts for the near-zero replication feature, validating performance, scalability, and reliability for seamless data synchronization.

positions.title: Scrum Master
positions.description:
• Reduced carryover work by 50% by aligning sprint scope to team capacity and tightening refinement, maintaining a stable velocity range across multiple sprints for the 9-member GUI team.

• Coordinated at the program level within the Scrum@Scale framework, partnering with 2 teams, the Chief PO, and the Program Scrum Master to resolve cross-team dependencies and keep roadmap objectives on track.

• Supported alignment at the solution level across 5+ teams, enhancing transparency for features impacting the broader PowerStore product.

• Served as the primary escalation path for impediments, resolving blockers promptly and helping the team sustain a steady delivery flow.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Validation of Remote Server Management Systems for Enterprise Server Platforms (iDRAC)

• Utilized an in-house Python framework to enhance sensor integration and perform design validation by injecting
simulated data into the remote server management system, ensuring defect-free production for enterprise servers.
• Migrated testing environments from previous-generation enterprise servers to next-generation hardware,
establishing consistent and reliable tests to validate system performance.
• Developed comprehensive documentation and conducted ramp-up sessions to onboard and support the next
rotation engineer, ensuring a seamless knowledge transfer and efficient team integration.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot, validate, and resolve critical system issues before
production release.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Messenger Kids Exp

• Enabled support for landscape mode for the inbox view and menu using Objective-C for their messaging app for kids in iOS devices (iPhone and iPad).
• Responsible for software maintenance across the codebase. Required wide understanding of the internals of the software and systems.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant: Advanced Programing Lab Instructor
positions.description:
• Taught C++ programming and logic courses utilizing an in-house created curriculum and other appropriate learning activities. Correspondingly, I graded labs, homework, projects, and exams of the course.
• Held weekly office hours in which students may come to clarify doubts or solve other problems related to the class.

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description:
•	Created a full stack social networking app in Objective-c in 5 weeks to podcaster where the user can post his mini-podcast with filter. Used the iTunes Search API for searching podcast and Parse Database for file storage.
•	Also created several side projects through a CodePath iOS development course, including a Twitter client, an Instagram clone, and a Flixster-like movie information app.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description:
Undergrad Research Fellow with Dr. Eduardo Ortiz
 
• Leaded the end-to-end creation of an app using Swift to identify the recommended size in a photovoltaic system. 
• Created an implementation strategy that will add 3 new customer-centric features to the product and make it easier for the client to evaluate their personal system.

positions.title: NASA L’SPACE Mission Concept Academy
positions.description:
Participated in the Mission Concept Academy, a 12-week program with the purpose of engaging the participant students into rigorous, project-based STEM workforce development, as Team 5's Engineer Leader.

As Engineer Leader, I scheduled meetings, researched information, and designed with the engineering team a static lander for the moon Enceladus. Also, do the various sections of the PDR that are related to the engineering part and explained in more detail the lander and the mission.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Summer Insight Series
positions.description: Selected from an applicant pool of over 5000 students for an 8-week undergraduate program consisting of 3 modules: professional skill-building, networking best practices, and technical interview preparation

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description:
Undergrad Research Fellow with Dr. Luisa Seijo Maldonado 

•	Conduct research, compile data, and prepare papers for consideration and presentation by departments, committees and boards of directors

•	Prepare invoices, reports, memos, letters, and other documents, using word processing, spreadsheet, database, or presentation software

•	Obtained information that 30% of the water reserve is contaminated and 10% of houses of the community not have ceilings by the passage of Hurricane Maria
